title: Set up project foundation (HTML skeleton, meta tags, font fallbacks)
notes: Create index.html with proper DOCTYPE, charset, viewport, and retro font stack (VT323, Courier New). Include CSS/JS links.

title: Implement core Minesweeper game logic (grid, cells, mines, reveal/flag mechanics)
notes: Pure JS: create board data structure, cell class/object, mine placement, neighbor counting, flood fill reveal, win/lose detection.

title: Implement difficulty presets (beginner, intermediate, expert) and game initialization
notes: Define grid dimensions and mine counts per difficulty. Provide UI selector or keyboard toggle. Reset functionality.

title: Add timer and mine counter UI components
notes: Digital clock style counters. Timer starts on first reveal. Update every second. Display remaining unflagged mines.

title: Implement CRT terminal visual styling (scanlines, curvature, glow, vignette)
notes: CSS: background #0a0a0a, text #33ff00/amber. Overlay with repeating linear gradient for scanlines. Box-shadow glows. Border-radius for curved screen effect. Radial gradient vignette. Phosphor fade (text-shadow animation).

title: Add screen power-on/off and start flicker animations
notes: CSS keyframes: initial full-screen flicker + vertical roll effect. Fade in content. Optionally add 'turn off' animation on game end or restart.

title: Implement cell reveal/flag animation and responsive grid layout
notes: Transition effects: cells expand/fade when revealing. Flag icon placement animation. Grid uses CSS Grid with auto-fit for responsiveness. Maintain square cells.

title: Add win/loss overlay with restart button and animations
notes: Overlay with CRT-style border. Show result message. Button with glow effect. Restart keeps same difficulty or allows selection.

title: Implement keyboard navigation and accessibility
notes: Arrow keys move focus cell. Space/Enter reveals. F toggles flag. R restarts. Trap focus within grid. Ensure contrast and ARIA where needed.

title: Final polish, cross-browser testing, offline verification
notes: Check no external deps (no Google Fonts unless base64 fallback). Verify no network requests. Adjust colors for contrast. Test Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge.

title: Push final code to GitHub repo and enable GitHub Pages
notes: Commit all files to main branch. Use gh to enable Pages: gh api -X PUT repos/nimbusswarm/atlas-sweeper/pages --field source='{"branch":"main","path":"/"}' or fallback to manual instructions.
